+def _get_fill_value(dtype, fill_value):
+    """Get the appropriate fill value for a variable."""
+    import numpy as np
+    if fill_value is dtypes.NA:
+        # Use NaN for floating point, or the fill_value for other types
+        if np.issubdtype(dtype, np.floating):
+            return np.nan
+        else:
+            return fill_value
+    return fill_value
+
+
+def _create_missing_variable(dims, shape, dtype, fill_value):
+    """Create a variable filled with fill_value matching the shape and dims."""
+    import numpy as np
+    fill_val = _get_fill_value(dtype, fill_value)
+    data = np.full(shape, fill_val, dtype=dtype)
+    return Variable(dims, data)
+
